title: Multiple Pending Card Charges
content: Multiple payment attempts may create temporary pending authorizations. Billing support should review repeated charges before advising the customer.

title: Error 500 Troubleshooting
content: HTTP 500 errors affecting multiple users may indicate a service-side or regional issue. Enterprise-wide incidents should be escalated.

title: Dark Mode Settings
content: Theme settings are available under Settings > Appearance. System Default follows the operating system theme when supported.
